_source: Adapted from 'Reference: Announcement Categories & Financial Glossary' (ENAM build challenge companion).

categories.label: Results
categories.desc: Quarterly/annual results, the board meeting approving them, results decks, ads confirming publication.

categories.label: M&A
categories.desc: Acquisition, merger, demerger, JV, investing in or selling a stake in a subsidiary.

categories.label: Fund raise
categories.desc: Rights issue, QIP, preferential allotment, buyback, commercial paper or other debt.

categories.label: Management change
categories.desc: CEO, CFO, MD or director joining, resigning or retiring.

categories.label: Litigation
categories.desc: Lawsuits, regulatory orders, fines, warnings, insolvency proceedings.

categories.label: Insider trade
categories.desc: A promoter or insider buying or selling their own shares.

categories.label: Earnings call
categories.desc: Call notice, transcript or recording link.

categories.label: Investor meeting
categories.desc: Meetings with specific investors or funds, conference attendance.

categories.label: Credit rating
categories.desc: A rating agency assigning, upgrading, downgrading or reaffirming a rating.

categories.label: Dividend
categories.desc: A cash dividend with its record date.

categories.label: Capex
categories.desc: Approving spend on a new plant, facility or capacity.

categories.label: Press release
categories.desc: Order wins, new products, partnerships, rumour clarifications.

categories.label: Pledging
categories.desc: A promoter pledging or releasing shares.

categories.label: Routine paperwork
categories.desc: ESOP allotments, compliance certificates, ESG reports, auditor appointments.
